fullPassage: Coping with impulsivity is a more complicated ability than it appears, and for a long time we thought only humans could do it. If you put candy in front of a group of children and tell them that if they can resist eating it, they will eventually receive even more candy, a few interesting behaviors will follow. Some of the kids will try to distract themselves by playing with toys or drawing as a way to cope with the frustration of delaying gratification (some of the kids will just give up and grab the candy). This is quite advanced problem solving behavior, which is why it was surprising to find out that chimpanzees can do it, too. Researchers showed a group of chimps a small pile of candy that was accumulating more candy as time passed by, but the candy was inaccessible to them. Then they gave the chimps a set of toys. Every so often they would allow the chimps to have access to the candy. Several of the chimps caught on that the longer they waited, the more candy would accumulate, so they distracted themselves with the toys to avoid grabbing the candy until they could get a hefty amount. The chimps became intensely focused on the toys when the candy became accessible, showing that they really were diverting their attention so they could get a bigger reward later.

det.korean: ③attract(끌어당기다) → distract(주의를 돌리다)가 문맥상 적절

① appears(보이다) ✅ — 충동 조절 능력이 '보이는 것보다' 복잡하다는 문맥에 적절

④ accumulating(쌓이는) ✅ — 사탕 더미가 시간이 지나며 늘어난다는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: distract(주의를 돌리다) vs attract(끌어들이다) — 반대 방향의 동사. 문맥상 '유혹에서 멀어지려는' 행동이므로 distract가 맞음

① surprising(놀라운) ✅ — 침팬지도 이 행동을 한다는 것이 놀라웠다는 문맥에 적절

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용으로 옳은 것은?

det.korean: 본문: 'Some of the kids will try to distract themselves by playing with toys or drawing' — 장난감 놀이 · 그림 그리기로 주의를 돌림

❌ ① 사탕을 더 오래 참을수록 아이는 더 적은 보상을 받는다 — 본문은 오히려 더 많이 받는다고 함(eventually receive even more candy)
❌ ② 침팬지는 사탕이 보여도 전혀 신경 쓰지 않았다 — 침팬지는 사탕에 집중했다(intensely focused)
❌ ③ 연구자들은 처음부터 침팬지에게 장난감 없이 사탕만 주었다 — 연구자들은 장난감을 주었음(gave the chimps a set of toys)
✅ ④ 일부 아이들은 장난감 놀이나 그림 그리기로 주의를 돌려 유혹을 참아낸다 — 'try to distract themselves by playing with toys or drawing' ←정답
det.tip: distract themselves = 스스로 주의를 돌리다. 만족 지연의 핵심 전략

ch: 사탕을 더 오래 참을수록 아이는 더 적은 보상을 받는다.
침팬지는 사탕이 보여도 전혀 신경 쓰지 않았다.
연구자들은 처음부터 침팬지에게 장난감 없이 사탕만 주었다.
일부 아이들은 장난감 놀이나 그림 그리기로 주의를 돌려 유혹을 참아낸다.

❌ ① losing their patience(참을성을 잃었다) — 오히려 참아내고 있었다는 문맥과 반대
❌ ② forgetting about the reward(보상을 잊어버렸다) — 보상을 얻기 위해 행동했으므로 반대
❌ ③ competing with each other(서로 경쟁했다) — 본문에 없는 내용
✅ ④ diverting their attention(주의를 다른 곳으로 돌리고 있었다) — 장난감에 집중함으로써 사탕에서 주의를 돌렸다는 문맥과 일치 ←정답
det.tip: divert attention = 주의를 돌리다. 만족 지연 전략의 핵심 표현

questions.passage: Coping with impulsivity is a more complicated ability than it appears, and for a long time we thought only humans could do it. If you put candy in front of a group of children and tell them that if they can resist eating it, they will eventually receive even more candy, a few interesting behaviors will follow. Some of the kids will try to distract themselves by playing with toys or drawing as a way to cope with the frustration of delaying gratification (some of the kids will just give up and grab the candy). This is quite advanced problem solving behavior, which is why it was surprising to find out that chimpanzees can do it, too. Researchers showed a group of chimps a small pile of candy that was accumulating more candy as time passed by, but the candy was inaccessible to them. (①) Every so often they would allow the chimps to have access to the candy. (②) Several of the chimps caught on that the longer they waited, the more candy would accumulate, so they distracted themselves with the toys to avoid grabbing the candy until they could get a hefty amount. (③) The chimps became intensely focused on the toys when the candy became accessible, showing that they really were diverting their attention so they could get a bigger reward later. (④)
questions.stem: 글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은? Then they gave the chimps a set of toys.

det.korean: 연구자들이 사탕 더미를 보여준 뒤(researchers showed ... a small pile of candy), 장난감을 주었다는 내용이 ① 자리에 들어가야 이어지는 'Every so often they would allow the chimps to have access'가 자연스럽게 연결된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① — 사탕을 보여준 직후 장난감을 지급했다는 흐름이 'Every so often...'으로 자연스럽게 이어짐 ←정답
❌ ② — 이미 장난감을 받은 상태에서의 행동(caught on)이 이어지므로 뒤늦게 들어가면 흐름이 끊김
❌ ③ — 침팬지들의 집중 반응을 설명하는 문장 뒤라 시간상 어색함
❌ ④ — 글의 마지막 결론 문장 뒤에는 시간상 맞지 않음
det.tip: Then(그러고 나서)이 들어간 문장은 시간 순서상 바로 다음 사건을 가리킴

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

Coping with impulsivity is a more complicated ability than it appears, and for a long time we thought only humans could do it.

(A) Several of the chimps caught on that the longer they waited, the more candy would accumulate, so they distracted themselves with the toys to avoid grabbing the candy until they could get a hefty amount.

(B) Some of the kids will try to distract themselves by playing with toys or drawing as a way to cope with the frustration of delaying gratification (some of the kids will just give up and grab the candy).

(C) This is quite advanced problem solving behavior, which is why it was surprising to find out that chimpanzees can do it, too. Researchers showed a group of chimps a small pile of candy that was accumulating more candy as time passed by, but the candy was inaccessible to them.

det.analysis:
✅ ② (B)-(C)-(A): (B) 아이들이 사탕 앞에서 보이는 행동 소개 → (C) '이것(This)'이 (B)의 아이들 행동을 가리키며 침팬지 실험으로 연결 → (A) 침팬지가 실제로 그 전략을 실행 ←정답
❌ ① (A)-(B)-(C): (A)의 'the chimps'를 받을 선행 설명이 없어 지칭이 갑작스러움
❌ ③ (B)-(A)-(C): 침팬지 실험 설정((C))이 되기 전에 (A)의 침팬지 행동이 먼저 나와 흐름이 끊김
❌ ④ (C)-(A)-(B): (C)의 'This is quite advanced ...'가 가리킬 아이들 행동((B))이 먼저 나와야 함
det.tip: (C)의 'This'가 (B)의 아이들 행동을 가리킴 → (B) 다음 (C). (A)는 (C)에서 설정된 실험이 전개되는 결과이므로 마지막

Every so often they would allow the chimps to have access to the candy. The chimps became intensely focused on the toys when the candy became accessible, showing that they really were diverting their attention so they could get a bigger reward ④<u>later</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③much → more ('the 비교급, the 비교급' 상관구문에서 비교급 자리에는 more가 와야 함. much는 비교급이 아님)
det.analysis:
① appears ✅ — 'than it appears'는 현재시제로 일반적 사실을 나타내어 적절
② can ✅ — 'chimpanzees can do it'은 능력을 나타내는 조동사로 적절
③ much ❌ — 'the longer ..., the ___ candy would accumulate'는 'the 비교급, the 비교급' 상관구문이므로 much → more가 맞음 ←정답
④ later ✅ — 'a bigger reward later'의 later는 부사로 적절
det.tip: 'the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 ~' 구문은 양쪽 모두 비교급 형태 필요. the much (X) → the more (O)

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 [조건]을 사용하여 문장을 완성하시오.
(아이들 중 일부는 그냥 포기하고 사탕을 움켜쥔다.)
[조건] (1) grab, candy, give, the, and, up을 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것
(영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 본문: '(some of the kids will just give up and grab the candy)' — 포기하고 사탕을 움켜쥔다는 표현
det.analysis: 'give up and grab the candy'는 '포기하고 사탕을 움켜쥐다'라는 의미로, give up(포기하다)과 grab(움켜쥐다)이 and로 연결된 병렬 구조이다. [조건]에 제시된 단어를 모두 사용하여 'give up and grab the candy'로 완성한다.
det.tip: give up(포기하다) + and + grab(움켜쥐다) the candy — 두 동사구가 and로 병렬 연결

to avoid __________ (grab) the candy until they could get a hefty amount.
